resources.string: Scroll through My Cards in the game, then tap Stop.
Lets PocketDeck scroll the card list in Pokémon TCG Pocket by itself while it scans your collection. It performs swipe gestures only and does not read anything on the screen.
Auto-scroll is off. Switch it on in Accessibility settings.
Open My Cards in the game (3 cards per row) to scan.
Stopped: the list is longer than expected.
